flow.name: Child's pose
flow.cue: Knees wide, hips back toward your heels, arms long.

flow.name: Cobra
flow.cue: Hips stay down; press through the palms and lift the chest gently.

flow.name: Downward dog
flow.cue: Hips high, heels reaching down, long spine.

flow.name: Standing forward bend
flow.cue: Soft knees, let your head hang heavy.

flow.name: High lunge
flow.cue: Front knee over ankle, back heel lifted, arms up.

flow.name: Crescent lunge
flow.cue: Square the hips, sink a little deeper, reach up.

flow.name: Extended puppy
flow.cue: From hands and knees, walk the hands forward, chest toward the mat.

flow.name: High lunge
flow.cue: Front knee over ankle, back heel lifted, arms up.

flow.name: Crescent lunge
flow.cue: Square the hips, sink a little deeper, reach up.

flow.name: Bridge
flow.cue: Feet hip-width, press through the heels, lift the hips.

flow.name: Supine twist
flow.cue: Knees drop to one side, both shoulders stay down.

flow.name: Supine twist
flow.cue: Knees drop to one side, both shoulders stay down.

flow.name: Wind release
flow.cue: Hug one knee to the chest, the other leg long.

flow.name: Wind release
flow.cue: Hug one knee to the chest, the other leg long.

flow.name: Seated side bend
flow.cue: Sit tall, reach the opposite arm overhead and lean.

flow.name: Seated side bend
flow.cue: Sit tall, reach the opposite arm overhead and lean.

flow.name: Seated twist
flow.cue: Lengthen up first, then turn from the ribs.

flow.name: Seated twist
flow.cue: Lengthen up first, then turn from the ribs.

flow.name: Seated mountain
flow.cue: Sit tall, arms overhead, slow breaths.

flow.name: Easy pose
flow.cue: Cross-legged, hands on knees, breathe slowly.

blocks.notes: 8 min Stretch Trainer, then 2 rounds of 16 poses (round 2 holds 2× from bridge on), 3 min easy-pose breathing
